status: Preregistered before implementation or new simulation
samplers: Exact original asset metadata for every actor; no tuning
snapshot: First public enemy contact, before that turn action; original first episodes only. Collect at most512games/opponent through turn600. First64 encountered distinct original-map hashes per opponent/seat, deterministic turn then row order; original map hashes globally unique. No outcome selection or refill beyond fixed collection.
public_candidates: Baseline is source categorical sample. Different-source alternative maximizes original probability among legal route-bit1 moves from a source cell different from baseline. Merge maximizes immediate own largest-stack growth over legal route-bit1 friendly full/half moves; require positive growth, break ties by source probability then lowest flat index. Pass is legal index3528. Unavailable alternatives duplicate baseline and are marked unavailable; identical actions remain paired duplicate controls.
transition: Duplicate exact full GameState for four actions and four replicas. Source and opponent always reobserve their own public view and resample after divergence. Initial action is forced once; then both original frozen actors resume. Replicas use independent seeded streams; four action branches share future source/opponent random keys within each original map/replica. Engine terminates at original absolute turn2000; freeze first terminal state/outcome and never autoreset.
primary: Mean signed terminal outcome(merge)-outcome(sampled_source), average four replicas within original map; percentile95% bootstrap clustered by original map hash. Includes unavailable duplicate merges as zero effects.
secondary: Different-source/pass contrasts and available-only/branch-turn summaries exploratory; no best-of-four selection or teacher qualification.
scope: Conditional first-contact states by turn600 against exactly two stateless frozen opponents; no hosted/Daveey strength claim, no training, promotion, or learned-teacher qualification.

runtime.throughput_gate: Not training; no training SPS claim
